policyDecision.reason: The latest 500-post preview found no untouched attested post satisfying both score and engagement floors. Lowering the floor would force a mutation without proving that the target meets the maintained product-quality policy.

allowedNextRoutes.description: Re-run the maintained preview until an untouched external attested post satisfies the unchanged floor.
eligibleWhen: preview attempted is false and ok is true
target is not authored by the active wallet
target has not already been reacted to or tipped by the active wallet
readbackRequired: reaction readback shows myReaction agree or an increased agree count
reply result has a tx hash
reply visibility passes through post_detail, parent thread, or feed readback

allowedNextRoutes.description: Create a separate reviewed target bead before any controlled self-created target is used.
requiredBeforeMutation: name the controlled parent target and its author wallet
state whether the parent target requires a separate live publish and count that publish in the tranche ledger
prove the parent indexed through product readback before any social mutation
explain why the target is not a trivial self-loop and what product behavior the social mutation proves
name cleanup or non-cleanup rationale; immutable chain posts cannot be deleted, so cleanup must be documented as non-applicable or replaced by follow-up labeling/readback
keep score >= 85 and engagement >= 5 unless a reviewed policy bead changes the floor with evidence
define the exact one-mutation command and explicit --execute flag
define reaction, reply, or tip readback as the success criterion before execution

blockedRoute.reason: The packet does not authorize lowering score or engagement thresholds to mutate the current top candidate.

verdict.summary: Social write lane is not live-mutation ready because current feed conditions are target-thin under the maintained policy. The next social mutation bead may only proceed after a fresh eligible preview or a separate controlled-target plan bead.
